statement.p: Which of the following are irrational numbers? There may be more than one correct answer.

solution.p: To be an irrational number, you simply have to not be a rational number. A rational number is a number that can be written as a fraction with whole numbers for the numerator and denominator, or with a terminating decimal expression, or with a repeating decimal expression. (Actually, these descriptions are a little redundant.) Sometimes rational numbers are explicitly written in one of these ways, and sometimes they are hidden. For example \sqrt{0.16} is a rational number, since \sqrt{0.16}=0.4. The irrational numbers here are are AG.
